entries.rationale: Tailwind 3 build dependency. Vulnerable braces execution observed only during trusted production compilation using repository-controlled content globs. No execution in backend, worker, Nginx runtime or inspected browser artifact. Production users cannot control the patterns supplied to braces. Reviewed 2026-10-11 for the shared closure GitHub verifier binding: only the read-only verifier dependency, explicit hosted workflow-token bindings and mocked consumer regression tests change. Frontend source, dependency locks, runtime packaging and build patterns are unchanged; canonical browser closure and runtime packaging were independently revalidated against the retained unfiltered hosted OSV report. Reviewed 2026-10-12 for full-capacity IAM no-op continuation: the change affects only coordinator planning, evidence checks, tests and operations documentation. The lockfiles, frontend source/build patterns and runtime packaging are unchanged; the unfiltered OSV scan still reports only the existing dev-only braces advisory, and a canonical browser build excludes braces. Reviewed 2026-10-12 for phase-local no-op policy artifact identity: only the production coordinator and mocked test change. Exact-branch OSV reports the same build-only braces finding; package locks, browser source, build patterns and runtime packaging are unchanged from protected main's passing canonical closure. Reviewed 2026-10-12 for authenticated Release Train gate retries: only the hosted coordinator's exact-run attempt validation and its tests change. The exact-branch unfiltered scan still reports only dev-only braces@3.0.3; the package locks, browser source, build patterns and runtime packaging are unchanged. The accepted scope, owner and expiry remain unchanged.
